shift.title: The layer that didn't vanish
shift.paragraph1: When coding agents arrived, some predicted pipelines and quality gates would fade away. The opposite happened: every agent-opened pull request triggers a pipeline, a review, a scan, a deployment. The delivery layer transformed from a developer convenience into the control point of the whole factory — and it has never been more active.
shift.paragraph2: Agents don't get tired, but they do get things wrong — at machine speed. A fabric only compounds value when every hypothesis it produces is validated by infrastructure that can spin up guardrailed environments in minutes, run the gates, promote what passes, and destroy the rest.
shift.warning: of agentic AI projects will be canceled by 2027, Gartner predicts — not because models fail, but because governance wasn't built for autonomous actors. The platforms that survive route agents through the same golden paths as humans.
